# Plati.market

> > Plati.market is a Russian digital marketplace for software, game accounts, subscriptions, gift cards, VPN services, and educational ebooks.

The platform specializes in instant delivery of digital products including premium subscriptions (ChatGPT, Netflix, Midjourney, Crunchyroll), gaming accounts (Epic Games, Origin/EA), VPN services (Express VPN, hidemy.name), payment cards (Amazon, Paysafecard), and educational materials across multiple disciplines. It serves as a comprehensive digital goods marketplace with automated delivery systems.

## Key Topics

- ChatGPT subscriptions
- Netflix accounts
- VPN services (Express VPN, hidemy.name)
- Midjourney subscriptions
- Epic Games accounts
- Origin/EA game accounts
- Digital gift cards
- Crunchyroll streaming
- Skype subscriptions
- RuTracker.org access
- Paysafecard codes
- Amazon.com gift cards
- Educational ebooks
- Game account marketplace
- Digital services marketplace

## Digital Services & Subscriptions

- [Сервисы (Netflix)](https://plati.market/cat/netflix/22704): Digital services: ChatGPT, Midjourney, Netflix, VPN subscriptions
- [Сервисы (Skype)](https://plati.market/cat/skype-accounts/18256): Digital services: ChatGPT Plus, Midjourney, Skype subscriptions
- [Сервисы (RuTracker)](https://plati.market/cat/rutracker-org/20339): Digital subscriptions: RuTracker, ChatGPT, Netflix, VPN services
- [VPN](https://plati.market/cat/vpn/71): VPN services and security software: ADGUARD VPN PREMIUM

## Gaming Accounts & Products

- [Аккаунты Epic Games](https://plati.market/cat/epic-games-accounts/26472): Epic Games accounts: Mount & Blade II, Alan Wake 2 Deluxe
- [Аккаунты Origin](https://plati.market/cat/origin-accounts/22763): Origin/EA app game accounts: SIMS 4, FIFA 22, It Takes Two
- [Warface](https://plati.market/cat/warface/22645): Warface FPS game keys and digital goods marketplace

## Gift Cards & Payment Systems

- [Amazon.com](https://plati.market/cat/amazon-com/22294): Amazon USA gift cards and certificates marketplace
- [Платежные системы](https://plati.market/cat/payment-systems/11674): Payment systems: Paysafecard digital codes and activation keys
